assistant.title: OpenAEC Assistant
assistant.greeting: Hello! I am the **OpenAEC Assistant**. I can: 🌐 translate, 📝 summarize, ✏️ draw on the drawing, and 🚪 detect doors. Pick a skill below or ask your question.

draw.label: Draw
draw.hint: Draw an element or annotation on the drawing

detect-doors.label: Detect doors
detect-doors.hint: Detect the doors in the floor plan and mark them

prompts.translate: Translate the text of the open document and present the translation clearly.
prompts.summarize: Summarize the open document or drawing concisely: what it is about, the main parts and any points of attention.
prompts.detect-doors: Look at the floor plan, identify the doors and mark each one on the drawing with a marker and a short label.
prompts.explain: Explain this document in plain language and unpack the jargon.
prompts.extract: Extract the key data from this document: names, dates, amounts, addresses and tables.
prompts.rewrite: Rewrite the text of this document for better readability.

errors.insufficientCredits: ⚠️ Out of credits. Top up your balance in the OpenAEC portal.
errors.notSignedIn: ⚠️ Not signed in. Sign in with your OpenAEC account, top right.
errors.rateLimited: ⚠️ Too many requests in a short time. Try again in a minute.
errors.noDocumentText: ⚠️ This document has no text layer, so there is nothing to send.
errors.offline: ⚠️ No connection to the AI service.
errors.needsRelay: ⚠️ This skill acts on the drawing itself, which needs a connected MCP client (for example Claude Code). None is connected right now.
errors.timeout: ⚠️ The AI service did not respond in time. It may be busy — try again in a moment.
errors.serverDown: ⚠️ The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly; your credits were not charged.

assistant.signInTitle: Sign in to use the assistant
assistant.signInSub: Summarizing, translating and Q&A run on your OpenAEC AI server and are billed to your credits. PDF editing keeps working offline.
